full_list.title_en: Comment on "InAs-Al hybrid devices passing the topological gap protocol", Microsoft Quantum, Phys. Rev. B 107, 245423 (2023)
full_list.title_zh: 对“通过拓扑间隙协议的 InAs-Al 混合器件”的评论，Microsoft Quantum，Phys。修订版 B 107, 245423 (2023)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2502.19560v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The topological gap protocol (TGP) is presented as "a series of stringent experimental tests" for the presence of topological superconductivity and associated Majorana zero modes. Here, we show that the TGP, "passed" by Microsoft Quantum [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)], lacks a consistent definition of "gap" or "topological", and even utilises different code when applied to theoretical simulations compared to experimental data. Furthermore, the outcome of the TGP is sensitive to the choice of magnetic field range, bias voltage range, data resolution, and cutter voltage pair (junction transparency) -- data parameters that, in PRB 107, 245423 (2023), vary significantly, even for measurements of the same device. As a result, the core claims of PRB 107, 245423 (2023) are based on unexplained measurement choices and inconsistent definitions. In particular, this means the claim by Microsoft Quantum in PRB 107, 245423 (2023) that their devices have a "high probability of being in the topological phase" is not reliable and should be revisited. In light of this, subsequent studies that are based on tuning up devices via the TGP should also be revisited.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑间隙协议（TGP）被描述为针对拓扑超导性和相关马约拉纳零模式的存在的“一系列严格的实验测试”。在这里，我们表明 Microsoft Quantum“通过”的 TGP [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)] 缺乏“间隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，甚至在应用于理论模拟与实验数据时使用不同的代码。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑间隙协议（TGP）被描述为针对拓扑超导性和相关马约拉纳零模式的存在的“一系列严格的实验测试”。在这里，我们表明 Microsoft Quantum“通过”的 TGP [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)] 缺乏“间隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，甚至在应用于理论模拟与实验数据时使用不同的代码。此外，TGP 的结果对磁场范围、偏置电压范围、数据分辨率和切割电压对（结透明度）的选择很敏感，这些数据参数在 PRB 107、245423 (2023) 中也有很大差异，即使对于同一设备的测量也是如此。因此，PRB 107, 245423 (2023) 的核心主张基于无法解释的测量选择和不一致的定义。特别是，这意味着 Microsoft Quantum 在 PRB 107, 245423 (2023) 中声称其设备“处于拓扑阶段的可能性很高”的说法并不可靠，应重新审视。有鉴于此，基于通过 TGP 调整设备的后续研究也应该重新审视。
full_list.summary: 拓扑间隙协议（TGP）被描述为针对拓扑超导性和相关马约拉纳零模式的存在的“一系列严格的实验测试”。在这里，我们表明 Microsoft Quantum“通过”的 TGP [PRB 107, 245423 (2023)] 缺乏“间隙”或“拓扑”的一致定义，甚至在应用于理论模拟与实验数据时使用不同的代码。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《对“通过拓扑间隙协议的 InAs-Al 混合器件”的评论，Microsoft Quantum，Phys。修订版 B 107, 245423 (2023)》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

The magnetic structure was deduced/determined from combined ⁵⁷Fe Mössbauer spectroscopy and ¹³⁹La-NMR on polycrystalline specimen. In this work, we present zero-field ¹³⁹La-NQR investigations on polycrystalline La₂O₂Fe₂OSe₂ in a broad frequency and temperature range between 2.8 - 20 MHz and 4.2 - 100 K. The measured resonances at ν_Q, 2 , ν_Q, and 3 , ν_Q are fully consistent with the previous NMR studies and also with the magnetic structure. A substantial modification of the electric field gradient at the La-position below T_N is inconsistent with the current investigations.

full_list.title_en: Disorder-Mediated Magnetism in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Monolayers: XS₂ and XSe₂ (X = Ti, V, Co, Mo, and Ru)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Disorder-Mediated Magnetism in Transition-Metal Dichalcogenide Monolayers: XS₂ and XSe₂ (X = Ti, V, Co, Mo, and Ru)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetism in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers has attracted considerable attention, yet its nature remains elusive, particularly in monolayer 1T-VSe₂. Our first-principles calculations show that Stoner instability can drive ferromagnetism in XS₂ and XSe₂ monolayers (X = Ti, V, Co, Mo, and Ru), associated with a reduced density of states at the Fermi level. We demonstrate that mixing nonmagnetic Ti, Co, Mo, and Ru disulfides or diselenides can induce magnetism. Conversely, mixing magnetic VS₂ or VSe₂ with other compounds can completely suppress magnetism. Both scenarios can lower the total energy. Moreover, substituting a small number of V atoms with Co defects can also disrupt ferromagnetism in 1T-V(S,Se)₂. Even in pristine 1T-VSe₂, we find ferrimagnetic configurations with reversed local V moments that are nearly degenerate with the ferromagnetic state. Their competition may contribute to the suppression of long-range ferromagnetic order. This reduced energy penalty for magnetic and structural disorder arises from a suppressed density of states at the Fermi level, resembling the mechanism underlying the Peierls transition. Electronically driven energy lowering near the Fermi level may therefore be widespread among transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers in various forms.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Combining topological insulators with chiral magnetic multilayers offers the opportunity to greatly enhance the spin-orbit torque (SOT) driven manipulation of hosted spin textures, however this also exposes devices to the often poor temperature stability of the commonly used, Bi₂X₃-based (X is a chalcogenic element), topological insulator films. In this work we demonstrate through in-situ-annealing and polarised neutron reflectometry that the multilayer at a Bi₂Se₃ interface remains magnetically robust up to a temperature of 350 cⁱrcC: even as the Bi₂Se₃ epilayer structurally deteriorates. Through x-ray photoemission electron microscopy, an intermediate annealing temperature of sim 200 cⁱrcC was found to improve the domain ordering of the multilayer, allowing for field-induced skyrmion nucleation, all whilst sustaining minimal damage to the topological insulator

full_list.title_en: Exotic vortex states and enhancement of orbital upper critical fields in an s-wave quasicrystalline superconductor
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Exotic vortex states and enhancement of orbital upper critical fields in an s-wave quasicrystalline superconductor
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals possess long-range order without translational symmetry, giving rise to intrinsically inhomogeneous superconducting states. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes mean-field theory, we investigate vortex states in an s-wave quasicrystalline superconductor on the Ammann-Beenker tiling, with particular emphasis on the high-field regime. We find that the vortex configuration can differ qualitatively from the Abrikosov triangular lattice. In particular, at filling ν=0.8, vortices preferentially penetrate weak-pairing regions centered on sites with coordination number 8, indicating that their spatial organization is strongly influenced by the local geometry. Furthermore, we observe an enhanced upper critical field. At ν=0.8, where the enhancement is particularly pronounced, the spatially averaged order parameter exhibits a plateau-like field dependence accompanied by the formation of vortex clusters. These clusters accommodate additional flux in locally weak superconducting regions, providing a microscopic interpretation of the plateau-like behavior. Moreover, the upper critical field increases upon cooling toward zero temperature without a clear sign of saturation.

full_list.title_en: Fast and Sensitive Readout of a Semiconductor Quantum Dot Using an In-Situ Microwave Resonator with Enhanced Gate Lever Arm
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fast and Sensitive Readout of a Semiconductor Quantum Dot Using an In-Situ Microwave Resonator with Enhanced Gate Lever Arm
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.00765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report an experimental study of a Si/SiGe double quantum dot (DQD) directly coupled to a niobium superconducting coplanar stripline (CPS) microwave resonator. This hybrid architecture enables high-bandwidth dispersive readout suitable for real-time feedback and error-correction protocols. Fast and sensitive readout is achieved primarily by optimizing the DQD gate lever arm, guided by MaSQE quantum dot simulations, which enhances the dispersive signal without requiring high-impedance resonators. We demonstrate a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of unity with an integration time of 34.54 nanoseconds, corresponding to a system bandwidth of 14.48 MHz and a charge sensitivity of 0.000186 e per square root hertz. Analysis of the voltage power spectral density (PSD) of the in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) baseband signals characterizes the system's readout noise, with the PSD's dependence on integration time providing insight into distinct physical regimes.

full_list.title_en: Field-Induced Weyl-Like Crossings and Longitudinal Magnetoconductivity in Dirac Systems
full_list.title_zh: 狄拉克系统中的场感类韦尔交叉和纵向磁导率
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2402.16859v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the field-induced separation of effective Weyl-like crossings and the associated longitudinal magnetoconductivity in Dirac systems using a finite-temperature quantum electrodynamics response-function approach. Starting from the one-loop photon polarization tensor in a magnetized fermionic medium, we identify a longitudinal electromagnetic mode associated with a nonvanishing pseudoscalar invariant bf E·bf B. We use this response to construct an effective low-energy Dirac model in which the two chiral sectors undergo opposite momentum shifts. Within this description, we derive an analytical expression for the longitudinal magnetoconductivity without introducing an independent phenomenological internode relaxation time. The chiral contribution contains an explicit B² prefactor, while its coefficient depends on the magnetic field and temperature through Landau-level thresholds and Fermi-Dirac occupation factors. The resulting conductivity exhibits a nonmonotonic magnetic-field dependence and an inverse-temperature regime under appropriate conditions. These results provide a connection, within the proposed effective model, between the longitudinal electromagnetic response, field-induced Weyl-like crossings, and longitudinal magnetotransport.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用有限温度量子电动力学响应函数方法研究了狄拉克系统中有效类外尔交叉的场致分离和相关的纵向磁导率。从磁化费米子介质中的单环光子偏振张量开始，我们识别了与非零赝标量不变量 bf E·bf B 相关的纵向电磁模式。我们使用这种响应构建了一个有效的低能狄拉克模型，其中两个手征扇区经历相反的动量位移。在这个描述中，我们推导了纵向磁导率的解析表达式，而不引入独立的现象学节间弛豫时间。手性贡献包含明确的 B² 前因子，而其系数通过朗道能级阈值和费米-狄拉克占据因子取决于磁场和温度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用有限温度量子电动力学响应函数方法研究了狄拉克系统中有效类外尔交叉的场致分离和相关的纵向磁导率。从磁化费米子介质中的单环光子偏振张量开始，我们识别了与非零赝标量不变量 bf E·bf B 相关的纵向电磁模式。我们使用这种响应构建了一个有效的低能狄拉克模型，其中两个手征扇区经历相反的动量位移。在这个描述中，我们推导了纵向磁导率的解析表达式，而不引入独立的现象学节间弛豫时间。手性贡献包含明确的 B² 前因子，而其系数通过朗道能级阈值和费米-狄拉克占据因子取决于磁场和温度。由此产生的电导率在适当的条件下表现出非单调的磁场依赖性和反温度状态。这些结果在所提出的有效模型内提供了纵向电磁响应、场感应类韦尔交叉和纵向磁输运之间的联系。

full_list.title_en: First-principles modeling of ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：First-principles modeling of ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The atomic ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys strongly influences their magnetic properties and mechanical behavior. While general features of long-range atomic ordering are known from the experimentally established phase diagram in this composition range, detailed atomic configurations and driving forces behind them remain speculative. Here, we address this gap by using effective cluster interactions (ECI) obtained from density functional theory (DFT) calculations and subsequent statistical thermodynamics modeling to unravel the interplay between magnetism, composition, and temperature in body-centered cubic (bcc) Fe-Si alloys up to 20 at% Si. Our analysis reveals that the ordering behavior is governed by a strong coupling between magnetic order, lattice expansion, and Si concentration, with specific ECI shells switching sign or magnitude as the magnetic state changes, which is reflected in the phase equilibria and ordering behavior of Fe-Si alloys. In particular, we demonstrate that D0₃ ordering is, in fact, primary in the totally ordered ferromagnetic state, while the B2 type of ordering is promoted in the paramagnetic state at elevated temperatures. The temperature-dependent evolution of these ordering patterns, obtained from Monte Carlo simulations based on the magnetically resolved ECIs, reproduces the experimentally observed phase equilibria and short-range order characteristics. By explicitly linking the magnetic state with the effective interactions and macroscopic phase behavior, this work establishes a predictive framework for an ab initio-based description of ordering in Fe-rich Fe-Si alloys and highlights the decisive role of magnetism in ordering phenomena in this system.

full_list.title_en: Framework to identify defect-insensitive electron transport in topological semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 识别拓扑半金属中缺陷不敏感电子传输的框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological semimetals are of increasing interest to replace conventional metals for interconnects in future semiconductor chips, due to their potential to exhibit decreasing resistivity with reducing wire dimensions and a lower sensitivity to electron scattering at defects. First-principles evaluation of promising topological semimetals for interconnects typically employ non-equilibrium Green's functions (NEGF) techniques to estimate defect scattering, but such calculations for specific defect geometries are difficult to systematize and compare between disparate materials. Here, we develop an NEGF-based approach to systematically and rapidly evaluate the defect sensitivity of electron transport in materials without depending on material-specific defect geometries. Specifically, we analyze the eigen-spectrum of the transmission matrix for an incoherent ensemble of all-possible single-atom vacancy defects, which clearly reveals eigenvalues close to 1 for defect-insensitive transport modes. Applied to the leading candidates, we show that this robustness to defect scattering is extremely sensitive to surface orientation and Fermi level for each material. We find nearly-perfect insensitivity to defects only for wavevectors with single transport modes within specific Fermi level ranges in CoSi(001) and PtAl(001). Importantly, we also find high insensitivity for certain non-isolated modes in NbAs that emerge specifically due to spin-orbit coupling; these modes could not be identified previously as they were buried in the total transmission. These non-isolated modes have been buried in previous studies of total transmission, and can now be directly compared to other materials due to our standardization of defect-creation. This technique improves the state-of-the-art NEGF method and enables unbiased evaluation of future topological semimetal candidates for nanoscale interconnects.
full_list.abstract_zh: 拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。具体来说，我们分析了所有可能的单原子空位缺陷的不相干系综的传输矩阵的特征谱，这清楚地揭示了缺陷不敏感传输模式的特征值接近 1。应用于主要候选材料，我们表明这种对缺陷散射的鲁棒性对每种材料的表面取向和费米能级极其敏感。我们发现，CoSi(001) 和 PtAl(001) 中特定费米能级范围内的单一传输模式波矢对缺陷几乎完全不敏感。重要的是，我们还发现 NbAs 中某些非孤立模式具有高度不敏感性，这些模式是由于自旋轨道耦合而出现的。这些模式以前无法识别，因为它们隐藏在总传输中。这些非隔离模式已被隐藏在之前的总传输研究中，由于我们对缺陷产生的标准化，现在可以直接与其他材料进行比较。该技术改进了最先进的 NEGF 方法，并能够对未来纳米级互连的拓扑半金属候选物进行公正的评估。
full_list.summary: 拓扑半金属在未来半导体芯片中替代传统金属互连的兴趣日益浓厚，因为它们有可能随着导线尺寸的减小而表现出电阻率降低的潜力，并且对缺陷处的电子散射具有较低的敏感性。对用于互连的有前途的拓扑半金属的第一性原理评估通常采用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）技术来估计缺陷散射，但这种针对特定缺陷几何形状的计算很难系统化并在不同材料之间进行比较。在这里，我们开发了一种基于 NEGF 的方法，可以系统、快速地评估材料中电子传输的缺陷敏感性，而不依赖于材料特定的缺陷几何形状。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《识别拓扑半金属中缺陷不敏感电子传输的框架》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: From Traveling Waves to Synthetic Gauge Fields: A Field-Free Route to Superconducting Diode Effect
full_list.title_zh: 从行波到合成规范场：超导二极管效应的无场途径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting diode effect requires the forward and reverse bias currents to differ, a scenario achieved via inversion and time-reversal symmetries broken together. The latter, and the more crucial one, is inevitably achieved by a magnetic field. Here, we show that a spatio-temporally driven chemical potential of the form, μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j), achieves both at once. Applied to a helical Shiba chain, the drive transmutes a traveling Peierls phase via generating an odd-in-momentum term, equivalent to an imaginary next-nearest-neighbour Haldane-like hopping in real space. Remarkably, the protocol is spin-blind, which renders the time-reversal breaking via a synthetic gauge flux rather than an effective Zeeman field. The rectification is odd in the drive wavevector, with exact zeros at kd=nπ and an analytical optimum at kd=2π/3. It is however, even in the exchange coupling, J and persists even at J=0. Furthermore, the rectification scales inversely with the pair-breaking gap, yielding approximately 50% rectification in the topological phase and 10% in the trivial phase. Symmetry breaking is thus drive-controlled, allowing it to be switched on, tuned, and reversed without an external magnetic field.
full_list.abstract_zh: 超导二极管效应要求正向和反向偏置电流不同，这是通过反转和时间反转对称性一起破坏来实现的情况。后者，也是更重要的一个，不可避免地要通过磁场来实现。在这里，我们证明了时空驱动的化学势 μⱼ(t)=μ+Vcos(ω t+kd j) 形式可以同时实现这两个目标。应用于螺旋柴犬链时，该驱动器通过生成奇数动量项来转变行进的 Peierls 相位，相当于真实空间中想象的次近邻 Haldane 式跳跃。值得注意的是，该协议是自旋盲的，它通过合成规范通量而不是有效的塞曼场来实现时间反转破坏。

full_list.title_en: Higher-order Angular Momentum Transport of Alteraxial Phonons in 2D Magnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Higher-order Angular Momentum Transport of Alteraxial Phonons in 2D Magnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling between lattice vibrations and magnetic order in two-dimensional (2D) magnets gives rise to a variety of physical phenomena, among which magnetic effects of axial phonons carrying phonon angular momentum (PAM) have attracted considerable interest. However, a systematic classification of axial phonons in 2D magnets that covers their multipolar patterns and the resulting transport manifestations remains largely unexplored. Here, based on symmetry analysis, we classify all 2D magnetic point groups by their long-wavelength PAM wave patterns. Beyond the s-wave axial phonon, we identify alteraxial phonons with p-, d-, f-, g-, and i-wave multipolar textures, characterized by 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 zero-PAM nodal lines, respectively. We then develop a theory of nonlinear PAM transport driven by a temperature gradient and derive two selection rules: a parity selection rule that determines whether the response occurs at even or odd orders, and an angular-harmonic selection rule that fixes the lowest allowed order for each wave pattern. The multipolar PAM patterns and selection rules are exemplified by two effective lattice models realizing f-wave and d-wave PAM patterns, respectivley. The angular dependence of the nonlinear PAM current reflects the underlying multipolar PAM texture, offering a signature for experiments. Our results establish a symmetry-guided framework for detecting and utilizing higher-order PAM textures in 2D magnets.

full_list.title_en: Hybridization-Induced Enhancement of the Thermoelectric Response in the Kagome Material CsCr₆Sb₆
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Hybridization-Induced Enhancement of the Thermoelectric Response in the Kagome Material CsCr₆Sb₆
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat bands in kagome lattices provide a prominent route to strongly correlated electronic states. Here we report charge and thermal transport measurements on single crystals of CsCr₆Sb₆, a kagome Kondo system arising from the hybridization between flat and dispersive bands. The Seebeck coefficient and Nernst signal increase rapidly below T_Fsim70 K, concomitant with the emergence of short-range antiferromagnetic correlations and flat-band resonance. The Nernst coefficient in the intermediate-temperature range of sim30-80 K further follows the universal scaling reported for prototypical heavy-fermion compounds, consistent with the development of strongly renormalized quasiparticles associated with hybridization. Both the Seebeck and Nernst responses reach extrema at a lower temperature Tₚsim20-25 K, where phonon drag and correlated quasiparticles may both contribute. These results reveal a hybridization-induced enhancement of the thermoelectric response and establish CsCr₆Sb₆ as a kagome platform for probing flat-band-derived Kondo physics through thermoelectric transport.

full_list.title_en: Intertwined complex orbital order and ferrimagnetism in honeycomb molybdate Fe₂Mo₃O₈
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Intertwined complex orbital order and ferrimagnetism in honeycomb molybdate Fe₂Mo₃O₈
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent experimental interest in honeycomb molybdates A₂Mo₃O₈, we return and develop the minimal models to capture the essential physics for Fe₂Mo₃O₈. It is pointed out that, the magnetism in these materials arises from the mutual induction between the spin-orbit coupling of the tetrahedral sublattice with active orbitals and the superexchange with the spins from the octahedral sublattice. Essentially, the superexchange between the tetrahedral and octahedral sublattices directly drives the ferrimagnetism, and the residual spin-orbit coupling on the tetrahedral sublattice induces the complex orbital order. The hybrid magnon-phonon excitations are further explored together with their resulting Berry curvatures and thermal Hall effect. We discuss the experimental relevance with Fe₂Mo₃O₈, and the framework can be extended to FeNiMo₃O₈, Ni₂Mo₃O₈ and other isostructural magnets.

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Intertwined complex orbital order and ferrimagnetism in honeycomb molybdate Fe₂Mo₃O₈》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Josephson effect in symmetry-mismatched van der Waals hybrid junctions of NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x and NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y
full_list.title_zh: NbSe2-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x与NbSe2-Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y对称不匹配范德华混合结中的Josephson效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coupling superconductors of different symmetries may lead to emergent quantum phenomena but experimental studies on heterojunctions made of lattice-mismatched crystals are scarce. Here, we fabricate Josephson junction by van der Waals stacking NbSe2 flakes on freshly cleaved surfaces of Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6+y. We obtain pronounced Josephson currents across the heterojunctions at temperatures below 7 K. The Josephson coupling strength, characterized by the product of the critical Josephson current I_c and the normal state resistance Rₙ, can reach about 0.3 mV, much exceeding the values previously reported in Pb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x or Nb-Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x junctions. Microwave irradiation induces integer Shapiro steps. We also observe the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern by applying an in-plane magnetic field. We compare our results with the theoretical calculations that take into account the coherent tunneling and the order parameter mixing. Our work demonstrates the hybrid junctions as a distinctive platform for addressing pairing symmetry and emergent quantum phenomena.
full_list.abstract_zh: 不同对称性的耦合超导体可能导致出现量子现象，但由晶格不匹配的晶体组成的异质结的实验研究很少。在这里，我们通过在Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8 + x或Bi2Sr2-xLaxCuO6 + y的新鲜裂解表面上堆叠NbSe2薄片来制造Josephson结。我们在低于7 K的温度下获得跨异质结的显著约瑟夫森电流。

full_list.title_en: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Large anisotropic magnetoresistance in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) usually relies on magnetic ordering, which fixes a preferred moment orientation and couples it to charge transport. Here, we demonstrate that pronounced AMR can instead arise from the anisotropic magnetic-field-induced polarization of dilute local moments in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4, a quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals narrow-gap semiconductor. Magnetization measurements reveal Curie-like paramagnetism down to 2 K, with the c axis as the magnetic easy axis. The magnetization is described by an effective S = 1/2 model with an anisotropic g-factor ratio of g_c/g_ab = 1.43(1). With the electrical current applied along the c axis, the Fe-doped sample exhibits a large negative magnetoresistance for B//c and only a weak positive response for B//ab, whereas the undoped sample shows little magnetoresistance for either field orientation. The resulting AMR ratio reaches -33% at 8 K and 10 T and exhibits a nonmonotonic temperature dependence qualitatively captured by a minimal spin-disorder model. These results show that engineering the local environment of dilute magnetic ions provides a route to large paramagnetic AMR without long-range magnetic order, extending the materials design space for AMR beyond magnetically ordered systems.

full_list.title_en: Magnetization and Josephson current coupling drives the Josephson diode effect in FeTe0.55Se0.45 van der Waals junctions
full_list.title_zh: 磁化和约瑟夫森电流耦合驱动FeTe0.55Se0.45 van der Waals结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Josephson diode effect (JDE) reflects symmetry breaking in the current-phase relation (CPR) of Josephson junctions, yet establishing its microscopic origin is often challenging. We investigate the mechanism of the JDE in van der Waals Josephson junctions based on FeTe0.55Se0.45, a platform where superconductivity, topology, and magnetism may coexist at the interface. Our devices exhibit a robust zero-field diode response with asymmetric switching currents. Magnetic-field measurements reveal a hysteretic Fraunhofer pattern and magnetic-resonance-induced voltage feature, evidencing interfacial magnetism coupled to the Josephson current. Microwave response further shows half-integer Shapiro steps with asymmetric evolution, demonstrating contributions from both a second harmonic and a magnetization-induced phase shift in CPR. Numerical simulations combining magnetization dynamics and Josephson phase dynamics reproduce these features, confirming that the JDE originates from interfacial coupling between magnetization and Josephson current. This work provides a transport-based route to pinpoint the microscopic mechanism of the JDE, establishing a platform for exploring magnetically active interfacial superconductivity, and enables the design of nonreciprocal superconducting devices in clean, interface-engineered van der Waals systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森二极管效应（ JDE ）反映了约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系（ CPR ）中的对称性断裂，但确定其微观起源往往具有挑战性。我们基于FeTe0.55Se0.45研究了JDE在范德华约瑟夫森结中的机制， FeTe0.55Se0.45是一个超导、拓扑和磁性可能共存于界面的平台。我们的器件具有强大的零场二极管响应和非对称开关电流。磁场测量揭示了滞后弗劳恩霍夫图案和磁共振诱导电压特征，证明了与约瑟夫森电流耦合的界面磁性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 约瑟夫森二极管效应（ JDE ）反映了约瑟夫森结的电流-相位关系（ CPR ）中的对称性断裂，但确定其微观起源往往具有挑战性。我们基于FeTe0.55Se0.45研究了JDE在范德华约瑟夫森结中的机制， FeTe0.55Se0.45是一个超导、拓扑和磁性可能共存于界面的平台。我们的器件具有强大的零场二极管响应和非对称开关电流。磁场测量揭示了滞后弗劳恩霍夫图案和磁共振诱导电压特征，证明了与约瑟夫森电流耦合的界面磁性。微波响应进一步显示了具有不对称演化的半整数Shapiro步骤，证明了心肺复苏中二次谐波和磁化诱导的相移的贡献。结合磁化动力学和约瑟夫森相位动力学的数值模拟再现了这些特征，证实了JDE起源于磁化与约瑟夫森电流之间的界面耦合。这项工作提供了一种基于传输的路线来精确定位JDE的微观机制，为探索磁性活性界面超导性建立了一个平台，并使清洁的界面工程范德瓦尔斯系统中的非互易超导器件的设计成为可能。

full_list.title_en: On thermal Hall effect in boson systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：On thermal Hall effect in boson systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically discuss the thermal Hall effect (THE) in boson systems keeping in mind possible applications to magnetically ordered insulators with skyrmion lattice ground state. The magnon spectrum of such systems may undergo a topological transition upon the variation of magnetic field, and THE could be a tool to confirm this phenomenon. We rederive formulas, suitable for our purposes, and find expressions which have a different temperature dependence of THE as compared to previously reported results. Particularly, in presence of anomalous terms in magnon Hamiltonian the thermal Hall conductivity has a small but finite residual 1/T contribution. Such contribution may become sizable at very low temperatures and resembles Meissner effect in superconducting metals.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《On thermal Hall effect in boson systems》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Paramagnetic phase of MnTe₂: complete one phonon Raman spectrum
full_list.title_zh: MnTe ₂的顺磁相：完成一个声子拉曼光谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.28844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study we present a complete first-order Raman scattering spectrum of paramagnetic phase of MnTe₂- a material, where new type of spin texture induced by noncoplanar antiferromagnetic ordering below the Néel temperature (T_N approx 90 K) gives rise to unconventional scenario of magnetism. Basic properties of all five phonon modes (A_g, E_g and three T_g) predicted by the group theory have been successfully approached through polarization, excitation and temperature dependent measurements. In particular, the ever-missing phonon mode of T_g symmetry has been unambiguously resolved in the room temperature Raman spectrum at approximately 107 cm⁻¹, just 1.5 cm⁻¹ higher in frequency compared to the E_g mode. Density functional theory calculations reproduce the observed Raman-active phonon spectrum and support the assignment of all five first-order Raman modes, including the near-degeneracy of the E_g and one of the T_g vibrations. The calculations further reveal a dense manifold of low-energy antiferromagnetic spin configurations, separated from the ground state by only a few meV per formula unit. Furthermore, strong signals of inelastically scattered light from the paramagnetic (PM) phase of MnTe₂ were acquired with long wavelength excitations, i.e. 633 nm and 785 nm, revealing the 2A_g overtone at approx. 360 cm⁻¹. The enhanced absorption of the light in the near infrared range could be a putative reason behind the anomalous angular dependence of scattered intensity of the highest frequency T_g phonon mode (183 cm⁻¹) measured in PM MnTe₂ with parallelly aligned polarizers. Finally, upon cooling just below the T_N, the measured properties of phonons remained basically unperturbed by the incipient long-range antiferromagnetic ordering.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了MnTe ₂ （一种材料）顺磁相的完整一阶拉曼散射光谱，其中由低于Néel温度（ T_N约90 K ）的非共平面反铁磁有序引起的新型自旋织构产生了非常规的磁性场景。群论预测的所有五种声子模态（ A_g、E_g和三种T_g ）的基本特性已通过极化、激发和温度相关测量成功接近。特别是，在室温拉曼光谱中， T_g对称的不断丢失的声子模态已被明确地分辨为约107 cm 1 ，与E_g模态相比，频率仅高出1.5 cm 1。

full_list.title_en: Pseudomagnetic focusing of valley-polarized beams in strained graphene
full_list.title_zh: 应变石墨烯中谷偏振光束的赝磁聚焦
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2505.21056v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In addition to spin, the low-energy charge carriers in graphene have two inequivalent valley flavors K and K' related by time-reversal symmetry, which can potentially serve as carriers for additional information. One promising route of controlling the valley degree of freedom relies on strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields, which couple with opposite signs to the two valleys. In this work, we theoretically investigate quantum transport in strained graphene devices that host tailored pseudomagnetic field profiles for valley manipulation. We focus on experimentally feasible geometries and propose transverse pseudomagnetic focusing in a bent graphene ribbon as an efficient method for generating valley-polarized currents, even in presence of disorder. Our work highlights pseudomagneto-transport in graphene as a viable tool for valleytronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 除了自旋之外，石墨烯中的低能电荷载流子还具有通过时间反转对称性相关的两种不等价的谷味 K 和 K'，它们可以作为附加信息的载流子。控制谷自由度的一种有前途的途径依赖于应变引起的赝磁场，该磁场与两个谷的符号相反。在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了应变石墨烯器件中的量子传输，这些器件具有用于谷操纵的定制赝磁场分布。我们专注于实验上可行的几何形状，并提出弯曲石墨烯带中的横向赝磁聚焦作为产生谷极化电流的有效方法，即使存在无序。我们的工作强调石墨烯中的赝磁输运作为谷电子应用的可行工具。

full_list.title_en: Quantics tensor trains for multiloop functional renormalization group in multiorbital impurity models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantics tensor trains for multiloop functional renormalization group in multiorbital impurity models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The full frequency dependence of electronic interactions is central to dynamical correlations, but its numerical cost restricts multiorbital calculations. We formulate the multiloop functional renormalization group directly in the quantics tensor train representation, retaining all three independent vertex frequencies over broad ranges without an explicit high-frequency parametrization. Analytical tensor operators perform frequency transformations and internal summations without dense vertex intermediates. Multiloop corrections improve agreement of vertices and responses with independent references and reproduce the low-energy numerical renormalization group self-energy. Lower-temperature calculations resolve a quadratic frequency contribution to the analytically continued scattering rate. A degenerate two-orbital impurity exhibits distinct spin, orbital, and charge responses at fixed Hund coupling. In a compensated altermagnetic environment, an orbital-level splitting induces a local spin response despite zero magnetization of the unperturbed impurity. Increasing Hund coupling suppresses the orbital response while increasing its spin polarization. Renormalized one-particle propagation alone does not reproduce this strong polarization dependence. These results extend compressed multiloop calculations to dynamical correlations in multiorbital environments.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Interference Enhanced Rectification in Mesoscopic Nanowires
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum Interference Enhanced Rectification in Mesoscopic Nanowires
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.29484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoscale nonreciprocal elements are needed to control signal flow in scalable quantum technologies, but existing nonreciprocal components are often bulky. Here, we show that a strongly nonreciprocal current-voltage relation can arise entirely from coherent elastic scattering in a mesoscopic Rashba nanowire with gate-defined scatterers. We first identify the symmetry constraints that enforce reciprocal transmission in a phase coherent conductor even when inversion and time-reversal symmetry are broken. We then show how gates that are capacitively coupled to the leads, together with a magnetic scatterer or transverse subband mixing, can remove these constraints. In the weak-scattering regime, nonreciprocal conductance originates from interference between distinct backscattering paths. In the strong-scattering regime, nonreciprocity can be resonantly enhanced by the hybridization of the transmitting channel with bound states that arise from a higher transverse subband or spin-split band. In this regime, we find that a bias-induced change in the gate potentials of about one percent can produce an order-unity diode response, i.e., electrons are transmitted almost as in a clean wire for one bias polarity, whereas for the other polarity the current is strongly suppressed.

full_list.title_en: Reducing strain fluctuations in quantum dot devices by gate-layer stacking
full_list.title_zh: 通过栅层堆叠减少量子点器件中的应变波动
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2312.09235v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nanofabricated metal gate electrodes are commonly used to confine and control electrons in electrostatically defined quantum dots. However, these same gates impart strain-induced potential fluctuations that can potentially impair device functionality. Here we investigate strain fluctuations in Si/SiGe heterostructures, caused by (i) lattice mismatch, (ii) materials-dependent thermal contraction, and (iii) depositional stress in the metal gates.By simulating gate geometries, ranging from simple to realistically complicated, we identify two opposing effects in overlapping gate structures: (a) gate-driven behavior arising from isolated gates vs (b) oxide-driven behavior arising from the thin oxides separating the gates in an overlapping geometry. These limiting behaviors induce strains of opposite sign, pointing towards the possibility of suppressing strain fluctuations through careful design. Here, we demonstrate in numerical models, a nearly total suppression of short-range strain fluctuation through device optimization. These results suggest that strain fluctuations should not pose an insurmountable challenge to qubit uniformity, provided that oxide and overlapping gate thicknesses can be tuned.
full_list.abstract_zh: 纳米制造的金属栅电极通常用于限制和控制静电定义的量子点中的电子。然而，这些相同的栅极会产生应变引起的电位波动，这可能会损害器件的功能。在这里，我们研究了 Si/SiGe 异质结构中的应变波动，这些波动是由 (i) 晶格失配、(ii) 材料相关的热收缩和 (iii) 金属栅极中的沉积应力引起的。通过模拟从简单到实际复杂的栅极几何形状，我们确定了重叠栅极结构中的两种相反的影响：(a) 由隔离栅极引起的栅极驱动行为与 (b) 由重叠几何结构中分隔栅极的薄氧化物引起的氧化物驱动行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 纳米制造的金属栅电极通常用于限制和控制静电定义的量子点中的电子。然而，这些相同的栅极会产生应变引起的电位波动，这可能会损害器件的功能。在这里，我们研究了 Si/SiGe 异质结构中的应变波动，这些波动是由 (i) 晶格失配、(ii) 材料相关的热收缩和 (iii) 金属栅极中的沉积应力引起的。通过模拟从简单到实际复杂的栅极几何形状，我们确定了重叠栅极结构中的两种相反的影响：(a) 由隔离栅极引起的栅极驱动行为与 (b) 由重叠几何结构中分隔栅极的薄氧化物引起的氧化物驱动行为。这些限制行为会引起符号相反的应变，表明可以通过仔细的设计来抑制应变波动。在这里，我们在数值模型中演示了通过器件优化几乎完全抑制短程应变波动。这些结果表明，只要可以调整氧化物和重叠栅极的厚度，应变波动就不会对量子位均匀性构成不可克服的挑战。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《通过栅层堆叠减少量子点器件中的应变波动》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在密度泛函理论和电子结构计算、图神经网络结构—性质建模、等变神经网络与对称性保持表示、有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，并落到晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合、声子、有限温度和输运性质、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: Electronic crystals and quasicrystals in semiconductor quantum wells: an AI-powered discovery
core_items.title_zh: 半导体量子阱中的电子晶体和准晶体：人工智能驱动的发现
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2512.10909v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The homogeneous electron gas is a cornerstone of quantum condensed matter physics, providing the foundation for developing density functional theory and understanding electronic phases in semiconductors. However, theoretical understanding of strongly-correlated electrons in realistic semiconductor systems remains limited. In this work, we develop a neural network based variational approach to study quantum wells in three dimensional geometry for a variety of electron densities and well thicknesses. Starting from first principles, our unbiased AI-powered method reveals metallic and crystalline phases with both monolayer and bilayer charge distributions. In the emergent bilayer, we discover a new quantum phase of matter: the electronic quasicrystal.
core_items.abstract_zh: 均质电子气是量子凝聚态物理学的基石，为发展密度泛函理论和理解半导体中的电子相奠定了基础。然而，对现实半导体系统中强相关电子的理论理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于神经网络的变分方法来研究各种电子密度和阱厚度的三维几何中的量子阱。从第一原理开始，我们的无偏人工智能驱动方法揭示了具有单层和双层电荷分布的金属相和结晶相。在出现的双层中，我们发现了一种新的物质量子相：电子准晶体。

core_items.title_en: Machine Learning for High-Entropy Catalysts: Methods and Applications
core_items.title_zh: 高熵催化剂的机器学习：方法与应用
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.19837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit exceptional catalytic performance in various reactions due to their high configurational entropy, synergistic elemental effects, tunable electronic structures, and excellent structural stability. However, the vast compositional space of HEA catalysts makes traditional experimental and theoretical design costly and inefficient. In recent years, data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have emerged as powerful tools for studying HEAs in catalysis. Through predictive models and ML surrogates, researchers can decipher the intricate composition-structure-performance relationships of these materials. In addition, by leveraging large language models (LLMs) for knowledge extraction, hypothesis generation and validation, and as a foundation to build integrated design workflows, ML approaches can significantly accelerate the design of novel HEA catalysts. This review systematically summarizes the latest methodological advances and applications of ML methods for HEAs in catalysis, discusses the challenges, and offers insights into future research directions to support the rational design and efficient development of catalysts.
core_items.abstract_zh: 高熵合金（HEA）由于其高构型熵、协同元素效应、可调电子结构和优异的结构稳定性，在各种反应中表现出优异的催化性能。然而，HEA 催化剂的巨大组成空间使得传统的实验和理论设计成本高昂且效率低下。近年来，数据驱动的机器学习 (ML) 方法已成为研究催化中 HEA 的强大工具。通过预测模型和机器学习代理，研究人员可以破译这些材料复杂的成分-结构-性能关系。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《高熵催化剂的机器学习：方法与应用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: A Combined Tight Binding with Machine Learning Potential Model for Magnesium Compounds
core_items.title_zh: 镁化合物的紧结合与机器学习潜力模型相结合
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2606.25853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a model for magnesium-based systems that combines density functional tight binding (DFTB) with MACE, a machine learning interatomic potential (DFTB+MACE). In this model, the conventional repulsive potential, pair potential, is replaced by a many-body MACE potential. The MACE component of the model is trained on the difference between density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces and the corresponding DFTB values, but neglecting the pair potential contribution. Using this model we performed structural relaxation of MgO-CO2 adsorption systems, molecular dynamics calculations of water clusters and phonon spectrum calculations of stable fcc-MgO and metastable bcc-MgO structures. We compare the performance of our model with a pure MACE model and with DFT. We demonstrate that the DFTB+MACE model achieves improved accuracy relative to DFTB with a pair potential, in many cases with only a moderate increase in computational cost. In addition, it can provide electronic structures that most of the machine learning potentials cannot. The training dataset, originally developed for MACE, may not fully represent all regions of the potential surface we may encounter during simulations. Expanding the dataset for a wider potential surface is expected to further enhance predictive accuracy of DFTB+MACE model. Overall, the resulting DFTB+MACE framework enables simulations at length and time scales beyond the reach of first-principles methods while retaining an explicit description of electronic structures, making it particularly attractive for studying charge-transfer in materials.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种基于镁的系统模型，该模型将密度泛函紧结合 (DFTB) 与 MACE（一种机器学习原子间势 (DFTB+MACE)）相结合。在此模型中，传统的排斥势、对势被多体 MACE 势所取代。该模型的 MACE 组件根据密度泛函理论 (DFT) 能量和力之间的差异以及相应的 DFTB 值进行训练，但忽略了对的潜在贡献。使用该模型，我们进行了 MgO-CO2 吸附系统的结构弛豫、水簇的分子动力学计算以及稳定 fcc-MgO 和亚稳态 bcc-MgO 结构的声子谱计算。我们将模型的性能与纯 MACE 模型和 DFT 进行比较。我们证明，相对于具有配对潜力的 DFTB，DFTB+MACE 模型实现了更高的准确性，在许多情况下，计算成本仅略有增加。此外，它还可以提供大多数机器学习潜力无法提供的电子结构。最初为 MACE 开发的训练数据集可能无法完全代表我们在模拟过程中可能遇到的潜在表面的所有区域。扩展数据集以获得更广泛的潜在表面预计将进一步提高 DFTB+MACE 模型的预测准确性。总体而言，由此产生的 DFTB+MACE 框架能够在超出第一性原理方法范围的长度和时间尺度上进行模拟，同时保留对电子结构的明确描述，使其对于研究材料中的电荷转移特别有吸引力。

core_items.title_en: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
core_items.title_zh: SU(2)-分子磁学的等变旋量消息传递
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.29111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.
core_items.abstract_zh: 预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 预测分子磁性通常需要使用自旋轨道耦合 (SOC) 进行电子结构计算，而在许多分子中重复计算的成本很高。底层电子态可以转换为旋量，但等变代理通常仅使用整数秩特征。受到这些电子态的旋量性质的启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一种传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递和规范不变读数来进行独立于任意特征基选择的预测。对于钴单分子磁体候选物，eSpinor 相对于 NequIP 改进了零场分裂预测，包括对看不见的配体的预测。对于镝磁共振成像探针，尽管存在类似的静态晶体场误差和较少的参数，eSpinor 仍可在哈密顿量基线上改善真实的电子自旋相关性，同时准确预测水中和转移至甲醇后的低场核弛豫，而无需重新训练。总的来说，这些结果表明 SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递对于分子磁性来说是一种有用的归纳偏置。我们还发现，类似的静态张量误差可能会产生不同的动态误差，从而促使基于预期物理可观测值的准确性进行模型选择。

core_items.title_en: Electronic, structural and magnetic properties of goldene nanoribbons
core_items.title_zh: 金色纳米带的电子、结构和磁性特性
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.30010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, two-dimensional goldene, a single-atomic-layer gold sheet, has been experimentally realized and is expected to be a promising material for next-generation devices, offering new possibilities beyond three-dimensional bulk gold. Because quasi-one-dimensional derivatives can exhibit properties markedly different from their two-dimensional counterparts, we investigate the stability, electronic, and magnetic properties of goldene-based nanoribbons (GOLDNRs) using first-principles computational methods. Our findings demonstrate that the electronic structure of these nanoribbons depends strongly on both edge chirality and ribbon width. Depending on the boundary configuration, the systems can exhibit semiconducting behavior with electronic band gaps of approximately 0.77 eV and 0.04 eV, or retain metallic characteristics. Additionally, the edge regions act as electronically active sites that may significantly enhance chemical reactivity relative to the central regions. As the ribbon width increases, the metallic characteristics of the infinite goldene sheet are progressively recovered, while the influence of quantum confinement and edge effects on the central region diminishes. These results provide important insights into tailoring the physical properties of goldene through lateral confinement, highlighting its potential for applications in nanoscale field-effect transistors, spintronic devices, and catalysis.
core_items.abstract_zh: 最近，二维金（一种单原子层金片）已通过实验实现，有望成为下一代器件的有前途的材料，提供超越三维块状金的新可能性。由于准一维导数可以表现出与其二维对应物明显不同的特性，因此我们使用第一原理计算方法研究了金基纳米带（GOLDNR）的稳定性、电子和磁性。我们的研究结果表明，这些纳米带的电子结构强烈依赖于边缘手性和带宽度。根据边界配置，系统可以表现出电子带隙约为 0.77 eV 和 0.04 eV 的半导体行为，或保留金属特性。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《金色纳米带的电子、结构和磁性特性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：A General Topological Symmetry Index for Critical Orbits In Neural Network Loss Landscapes
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. The frameworks apply to arbitrary network architectures and include methods applicable to degenerate critical orbits. The index detects the isotropy of the critical points and quantifies the corresponding net topological contributions. Several examples, including softplus MLPs, Transformers, and equivariant neural networks, are presented to illustrate the computations.

core_items.title_en: SoLiD26: A First Principles Solid-Liquid Interface Dataset for Machine-learned Interatomic Potentials
core_items.title_zh: SoLiD26：用于机器学习原子间势的第一原理固液界面数据集
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.28013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable simulations of larger atomistic systems over longer timescales than traditional ab initio methods but require large, diverse training data. Existing datasets lack comprehensive sampling of solid-liquid interfaces, which exhibit complex phenomena such as solvent layering and surface reconstruction critical for energy and catalytic materials. Here, we present SoLiD26, a curated solid-liquid interface dataset of 15.4 million first-principles structures with up to 576 atoms and 15 chemical elements for training and evaluating MLIPs. The structures were compiled from density functional theory (DFT) calculations, with most configurations originating from ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. SoLiD26 includes aqueous coinage metal interfaces, electrode-electrolyte systems, and selected bulk reference structures, calculated with VASP using the PBE functional and D3 dispersion corrections. The application of SoLiD26 for training and evaluating MLIPs is demonstrated with a suite of MACE models on a simple training, validation and test split. This dataset provides a valuable resource for advancing MLIP development targeted at modelling solid-liquid interfaces in electrochemical and catalytic systems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 与传统的从头计算方法相比，机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 能够在更长的时间尺度上模拟更大的原子系统，但需要大量、多样化的训练数据。现有数据集缺乏对固液界面的全面采样，这些界面表现出复杂的现象，例如对于能源和催化材料至关重要的溶剂分层和表面重建。在这里，我们展示了 SoLiD26，这是一个精心策划的固液界面数据集，包含 1540 万个第一性原理结构，最多包含 576 个原子和 15 种化学元素，用于训练和评估 MLIP。

core_items.title_en: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
core_items.title_zh: 用于多模态 X 射线和中子散射反演的组合神经网络
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.29362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.
core_items.abstract_zh: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: X 射线和中子散射对于凝聚态物理和材料科学的结构表征是不可或缺的。然而，由于散射实验通常记录没有相位信息的强度，不同的结构可以产生相似的散射图案，从而使得相应的反演问题不唯一。通过组合互补测量可以减少这种模糊性，但将它们集成到机器学习框架中仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们介绍一个基于先验摊销流量匹配的概率多测量分析的模块化框架。单观测后验估计器针对各个观测类型或物理探针单独进行训练，并仅在推理时通过组合采样器进行组合。这种后期融合方法允许重复使用预训练的单观察模型，而无需专门的联合再训练。作为一个恰当的例子，我们考虑反射测量法，它提供有关薄膜和界面的深度分辨纳米级信息。我们的单次观测演示涵盖 X 射线、飞行时间中子和偏振中子反射计。在单独的协同细化研究中，任务匹配的估计器可以实现跨多个中子对比的均匀成分以及 X 射线和中子测量的异构多模态成分。总之，这些结果将成分流匹配建立为不确定性感知反演和协同细化的模块化方法，并具有对其他散射问题的潜在适用性，在其他散射问题中，多个观测值约束共同的物理结构，同时保留特定于测量的参数。
